intent_anchor.user_goal: Deliver a safe provider-neutral Paid AGM gateway while preserving the existing Grok workflow.
intent_anchor.current_priority: Independently verify budget, provider authority, idempotency and secret boundaries before acceptance.

claim_under_review: G5-001 enforces hard budgets, fixture-only provider authority, idempotency and fail-closed validation.
what_i_accept: Gateway unit suite passes 20 tests and the Godot paid adapter passes 14 checks.
Integrated Godot boot and project validator are clean.
Snapshot and Decision validation, deep secret-key redaction, retry classification and untrusted proposal routing are present.
Worker ownership and MAF receipts are consistent, and the parent did not self-accept.
what_i_challenge: Untrusted budget_context can replace configured server caps with larger values, allowing a request to bypass both hard caps.
NaN and Infinity budget values pass comparisons and reach the provider instead of failing closed.
An arbitrary injected ProviderInterface is called when allow_real_provider is false if the request labels its mode fixture.
A reused request_id or gateway_request_id with a different payload returns the prior response because idempotency is not bound to a canonical request fingerprint.
strongest_counter_argument: The service is currently fixture-only and not publicly exposed, but these are authority-boundary defects in the exact component intended to become the trusted Paid gateway, so accepting them would encode unsafe defaults.
missing_evidence: No adversarial test proves server caps cannot be raised by a client.
No test rejects non-finite budget inputs.
No test rejects a non-fixture provider object while real-provider authority is disabled.
No test rejects idempotency-key reuse with a changed canonical request.
The adversarial-review skill references schema files absent from its installed directory, so this object follows the documented fields but could not be schema-validated.
blind_spots: Real provider networking and credential lifecycle remain HITL and are not evaluated.
next_action: Apply WO-G5-001-CORRECTION-001, rerun the four adversarial cases and all existing G5/Godot/validator gates, then return to Codex.
